note: 07A V2: quote rejects two raw forms with wrong-number-of-arguments, naming the symbol and the count. Both sides' data is the list `(quote 2)`, and since sub-plan 11C both printers abbreviate it to `'2`, so the byte comparison is meaningful and the `compare_data: false` opt-out this case carried is gone. primitive-quote-too-many-nargs compares the same values extracted Lisp-side; writer-quote-forms owns the abbreviation itself.
